company.name: Reliable Robotics
company.shortDescription: Reliable Robotics develops automation systems for aircraft that enable remotely operated and autonomous flight operations.
company.description: Reliable Robotics develops automation systems for aircraft that enable remotely operated and autonomous flight operations. The company designs hardware and software that integrate with existing aircraft to manage navigation, communication, and flight control functions without onboard pilots. Its platform includes remote control stations, onboard automation technology, and systems for monitoring and managing flight operations. The company works with aviation stakeholders to adapt its technology for cargo and passenger aircraft while aligning with regulatory frameworks. Its activities focus on improving aircraft utilization and enabling new operational models in aviation.

productsAndServices.description: An aircraft automation system that enables remotely operated and autonomous flight, with the goal of reducing the need for onboard pilots during cargo and other aviation operations.

aiResearchSummary.text: Reliable Robotics Corporation is researching systems for automated aviation, including a selectively engageable detent system for aircraft operation that controls lever movement, a system for managing flight controls from a ground station for uncrewed aircraft, and methods for verifying flight system calibration and performing automated navigation actions using machine vision. Their work also covers compliance analysis for detect and avoid systems and integrity monitoring using satellite and inertial data.
